segments.he: עוד אמר רבינו ז"ל ווען וועט אמאל דאנקן אזמען וועט זיין דעם ציון פין דער וואטינס:
segments.en: This story was told to me by our dear friend Reb Shlomo Koilar of our fellowship from Iasi. He told that at that time there was a large gathering of our fellowship in Iasi and other communities of Romania. Many times they would suddenly gather together for some days at one of their homes — lock the gates and doors, and study Torah and Likutay Moharan together, do hisbodedus from the Torah they studied, and serve G-d according to what they learned. Reb Mikheli of Iasi was their head. And so they would all travel together to Uman — renting a wagon and traveling together several times a year and especially for Rosh HaShanah. And a relative who had joined them told of how from the very greeting they give one another in Uman, one can draw close to Rabbainu — for hundreds upon hundreds come from many countries, and some do not know each other at all, yet they give each other Sholom aleikhem with both hands and in a loud voice with great love and affection — and one asks the other: "My brother — how was your year? How did you serve Hashem?" And all the conversations are only about the ultimate purpose and the service of G-d. May Hashem grant me this soon, for all of Yisroel, amen.
